title: Case Study #1 · 911 Emergency Response Time
description: [Palantir 经典原版] A major city wants to use our platform to reduce 911 emergency response times. They have call data, traffic data, and ambulance GPS data. You have 60 minutes. Go.

title: Case Study #2 · Logistics AI Agent Rerouting (Eval Suite)
description: A logistics firm wants an AI agent to handle automated shipment rerouting. They have SAP data, real-time weather APIs, 500 warehouse managers on different regional systems. How do you build an eval suite to ensure the agent does not overspend on shipping while maintaining a 99% delivery rate?

title: Case Study #3 · Healthcare 12% Adoption Diagnosis
description: Healthcare client shows 12% adoption after 90 days. Diagnose root cause and propose remediation.

title: Case Study #4 · Legacy ERP Without API Layer
description: Integrate your AI platform with a 15-year-old on-premise ERP system that lacks an API layer. What's your approach?

title: Case Study #5 · Model Performs Worse Than Manual Process
description: After deployment, the model performs worse than the previous manual process the customer was using. How do you investigate and what do you do?

title: Technical #1 · OAuth 2.0 Integration (CRM ↔ Platform API)
description: Design an OAuth 1.0/2.0 integration bridging between a client's CRM and your platform API. Cover token exchange, middleware placement, retry logic, credential rotation.

title: Technical #2 · Debug Agent Inconsistency (Staging vs Prod)
description: An AI agent returns inconsistent results in production compared to staging. Walk through your debugging approach end-to-end.

title: Technical #3 · Data Pipeline Quality Drift Detection
description: Build a detection system for data pipeline quality degradation on specific days. Cover metrics, thresholds, alerting, and root-cause routing.

title: Technical #4 · Multi-tenant SaaS Monitoring (Varying SLAs)
description: Design multi-tenant SaaS monitoring with varying client SLA requirements. Per-tenant quotas, noisy-neighbor isolation, billable signal aggregation.

title: Technical #5 · Reliable Webhook with Flaky Clients
description: Design reliable webhook integration when client systems frequently go offline. Cover retry, idempotency, dead-letter handling, backpressure.

title: Technical #6 · File System Permissions (Python, hierarchy + timestamps)
description: [ElevenLabs] In Google Doc with Python: assess permissions in a file system based on user IDs. Account for hierarchy and timestamps.

title: Client Sim #1 · Live Demo Fails Before Executives
description: Your live demo fails in front of the client's executive team. What do you communicate, in what order, and how do you recover the deployment timeline?

title: Client Sim #2 · '6-Week Feature in 3 Days'
description: Client demands a 6-week feature delivered in 3 days. Manage expectations without losing the relationship.

title: Client Sim #3 · Recurring Fix Failure / Client Losing Confidence
description: Deployed fix fails; the same problem recurs; client is losing confidence in your team. How do you communicate, what do you change in your process?

title: Client Sim #4 · Explain Variable Model Output to Non-Tech CFO
description: Explain to a non-technical CFO why the model produces different outputs for the same input (non-determinism is not a bug). Without losing trust.

title: Client Sim #5 · IT Team Blocks Integration on Security Grounds
description: Client's IT team blocks your integration citing security concerns. Navigate the politics, get unblocked, ship the deployment.

title: AI Deep Dive #1 · 'Why did you choose that chunking strategy?'
description: [OpenAI Tech Screen] Follow-up on take-home RAG: Why did you choose that chunking strategy? Why not a different retrieval method?

title: AI Deep Dive #2 · 'What would you change if dataset was 100x?'
description: [OpenAI Tech Screen] Take-home was on small dataset. What would you change architecturally if the dataset was 100x larger?

title: AI Deep Dive #3 · 'Diagnose high latency in LLM inference pipeline'
description: [OpenAI Tech Screen] An LLM inference pipeline is showing high p99 latency in production. Walk through how you would diagnose it.

title: AI Deep Dive #4 · 'RAG vs Fine-tuning vs Prompt Engineering tradeoffs'
description: [OpenAI Technical Deep Dive] Walk through the tradeoffs of RAG vs fine-tuning vs prompt engineering. When does each win?

title: AI Deep Dive #5 · 'How do you know your AI system is actually working well?'
description: [OpenAI Deep Dive] How do you know your AI system is actually working well in production? Cover evaluation: automated metrics, human feedback, online vs offline.

title: Recruiter / HM #1 · 'Why FDE specifically?'
description: [OpenAI Recruiter] Why do you want FDE specifically versus other engineering roles at OpenAI / Google / etc?

title: Recruiter / HM #2 · 'How do you handle ambiguity?'
description: [OpenAI Hiring Manager] How do you handle ambiguity? Tell me a story where requirements were unclear and you had to make calls without complete information.

title: Solution Design #1 · 'What questions would you ask the customer first?'
description: [OpenAI Solution Design] Open-ended: design a complete AI solution for a company's business problem. But first — what questions would you ask the customer before designing anything?
